description: This Java class represents a response to a RetrieveSubjects command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains methods for creating instances from various input formats (including JSON), accessing response details like policy ID, label, and subjects, and serializing the response back to JSON. It is part of the package related to command responses for policies and signals in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectsResponse
classes.description: A class representing the response to a RetrieveSubjects command, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, accessors, and factory methods for creating instances.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of RetrieveSubjectsResponse with various parameter types, including JSON objects, strings, and typed PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveSubjectsResponse from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry whose subjects were retrieved.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the Subjects object representing the retrieved subjects.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the subjects to JSON based on the schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Replaces the entity (subjects) with a new JSON value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON pointer path for the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the response's payload fields to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate.
